description: Write an implementation plan with explicit decisions and acceptance criteria.

process_nodes.title: Establish scope and current evidence
process_nodes.description: Identify goals, existing behavior, constraints, owners, and relevant source documents.
success_criteria: Assumptions are separated from verified facts.

process_nodes.title: Define decisions and implementation sequence
process_nodes.description: Resolve design choices and dependencies before assigning implementation work.
success_criteria: Implementers are not left to make architectural choices.

process_nodes.title: Specify tests, gates, and handoff
process_nodes.description: Define acceptance evidence, safety boundaries, and status reporting.
success_criteria: Completion claims can be checked against concrete evidence.
